run_upload_gmock: run upload_gmock.py to upload a Google Mock patch for review with auto CC
run_upload_gmock_with_cc: run upload_gmock.py with custom CC flags to add additional reviewers to the patch upload
review_main: review the main function that wraps upload.py and ensures the Google Mock group is CC'd
summarize_upload_gmock: summarize the upload_gmock.py wrapper script that passes flags to upload.py with auto CC
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional default CC recipients for patch uploads
